faq3.title: Your car key questions, answered.
faq3.description: What to know before getting a key cut or a fob programmed.

items.q: Do I need an appointment to visit the shop?
items.a: Yes. Shop visits are by appointment at 598 State Route 5, Elbridge, NY 13060. Call or text 315-552-1553, or use our quick questions to prepare an appointment request. We’ll reply to confirm availability. If your situation is urgent, call or text us directly.

items.q: Are you an automotive locksmith in Elbridge, NY?
items.a: Yes. Car Key Supply is based in Elbridge, NY and specializes in automotive key cutting, replacement keys, key programming and key fobs. We serve drivers throughout Greater Syracuse and nearby Central New York communities.

items.q: What vehicles can you cut and program keys for?
items.a: We work with nearly every make and model, including many domestic, Asian and European vehicles. The exact key and programming options depend on the year, model and key system. Share those details so we can confirm your vehicle.

items.q: Do you have keys and key fobs in stock?
items.a: Yes. We carry a wide selection of automotive keys, fobs and remotes in stock. Inventory varies by vehicle, so check with us before making a trip to confirm the correct key or fob is available.

items.q: Can you program a push-to-start smart key?
items.a: We program compatible smart keys and key fobs for many push-to-start vehicles, as well as transponder keys and remote-head keys. We'll check the correct option for your vehicle.

items.q: Can you help if I have lost all my car keys?
items.a: Tell us your vehicle's year, make and model and that no working keys remain. We'll confirm whether we can help with your specific vehicle and explain what is needed for a replacement.

items.q: How much does a replacement key or key fob cost?
items.a: Pricing depends on your vehicle, the key or fob it uses, and the cutting and programming required. Share your year, make, model and whether you have a working key so we can discuss an accurate quote.

items.q: Do you serve Syracuse and the surrounding towns?
items.a: Yes. We’re based in Elbridge, NY and serve Greater Syracuse, including Jordan, Camillus, Liverpool, Baldwinsville, Clay, Cicero, North Syracuse, East Syracuse, DeWitt, Fayetteville, Manlius and Skaneateles, plus Fulton and Oswego County communities. Let us know where you are to confirm arrangements.

items.q: Can you program a key or fob I bought online?
items.a: Ask us before ordering. The part number, frequency and compatibility need to match your vehicle, and some used or aftermarket fobs may not be suitable for programming. We can check what you have and discuss an in-stock option.

items.q: What information should I have ready?
items.a: Start with your vehicle's year, make and model, your location, and whether any working keys remain. Tell us if you need a standard key, remote, or push-to-start fob. We'll explain any additional vehicle or ownership information needed when arranging service.
